chose: Home hands record:essay one audio file per answered ticket (<TICKET>.<ext>), with the take's word times beside it (<TICKET>.words.json) where home kept them. A take with no times is captioned by spreading the transcript across it, each word's share as long as its letters (spreadWords).
options: word times where home kept them, else the transcript spread by letters
captions only where home kept word times
the transcript shown whole for the length of the take
gray: The call's captions come from Kokoro's own word times, which an owner's take doesn't have. Whether home's transcriber keeps times is RR16-home's to settle, and the spread caption is something the owner sees in every essay.
undo: Change spreadWords in stills.ts, or have record:essay refuse a take with no .words.json (essayTakeFiles in essay.ts).
